headline: Mikel Arteta puts stale Arsenal display down to Nottingham Forest tactics: 'They put a Christmas tree there'
description: Mikel Arteta has defended his Arsenal team after they only managed one shot on target in their 1-0 win at Nottingham Forest on Sunday.

headline: Arsenal don't look ready to 'attack' the Premier League title like they want to -- yet
description: Defending Premier League champions Arsenal put in a weak attacking performance at Nottingham Forest -- but maybe that's just fine.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Could Viktor Gyökeres leave Arsenal in January?
description: Arsenal forward Viktor Gyökeres could leave the club in January, while Manchester United are looking to bolster their squad in January. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Premier League recap: Man United struggle and draw; Arsenal struggle and win
description: Arsenal got an important win as they look to keep pace with Manchester City at the top of the Premier League. ESPN's dedicated match blog has all the updates.

headline: Noni Madueke sinks Nottingham Forest with Arsenal's only shot on target
description: Noni Madueke climbed off the bench to earn toothless Arsenal a 1-0 win at Nottingham Forest.
